Spot-checks after each wave: verify SUMMARY.md exists, check git commits via grep on phase-plan pattern, verify key created files on disk, check for Self-Check: FAILED marker
Parallel wave execution spawns agents concurrently; orchestrator waits for all before proceeding to next wave
